request.style: English, male baritone solo, warm and solemn, solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, soft piano, strings, low drums, melancholic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The troops were encamped against Gibbethon
They heard that Zimri had struck down the king
All Israel in the camp that very day
Proclaimed the commander Omri their new king

[Chorus]
He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer
Built up the city with two talents of silver
He named it after the owner of the ground
A capital that would not be unbound

[Verse]
The people were split into two distinct sides
Half followed Tibni son of Ginath to reign
Half followed Omri in the battle lines
But Omri proved stronger than Tibni again
Tibni died and the war was done
Omri became king in the thirty-first year of Asa
He reigned twelve years in the northern land
Six years in Tirzah before he could rest

[Chorus]
He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer
Built up the city with two talents of silver
He named it after the owner of the ground
A capital that would not be unbound

[Bridge]
He did evil in the eyes of the Lord
Acting more wickedly than all before him
He followed the sin of Jeroboam son of Nebat
Provoking the God of Israel to anger
With worthless idols that brought them shame

[Outro]
Omri rested with his fathers
Buried in Samaria
His son Ahab took the throne
Continuing the ways of the old

[Chorus]
He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer
Built up the city with two talents of silver
He named it after the owner of the ground
A capital that would not be unbound
